title: Reasoning controls reach the chat API
summary:
Reasoning controls arrived for chat, image caching moved into Enter, and generation shed several tracking paths.

Chat requests now accept `reasoning_effort` and `thinking_budget`, and responses can pass through provider reasoning fields, including in streams. Text, image, and chat proxy errors also use structured responses while preserving upstream HTTP status codes.

Exact-match image caching moved into Enter’s image route. A cache hit returns the stored image before authentication or rate limiting; a miss follows the usual path to the image origin. Related cache changes addressed empty entries and image responses without a Content-Length header. The GPT Image connection was updated, while the Unity, naughty, and evil text model entries were removed.

Image and text telemetry, several request and conversation logging paths, and specified image-user blocking paths were removed. Content-safety checks and image-model hourly limits remain.

highlights.title: Reasoning controls for chat
highlights.text: Set `reasoning_effort` or `thinking_budget` in chat requests. Provider reasoning fields can also come through in regular and streaming responses. [Read the API docs](https://gen.pollinations.ai/docs).

highlights.title: Cached images without a key
highlights.text: An exact-match image cache hit now returns the stored image without requiring a key or another rate-limit check. Cache misses still follow the usual authentication and generation path.
